en.title: Batch 96: evaluate resources across the property lifecycle
en.description: Review six Zion property resources covering valuation, leases, screening, listings, maintenance and market research, with original app and repository links.
en.intro: The Batch 96 collection, introduced on 6 October 2026, follows six property tasks from valuation to market research. Use the app pages and source repositories to define a small evaluation with clear inputs and human review.
en.scope: These pages describe evaluation topics, not verified end-to-end property operations. Confirm actual functionality, licensing, access permissions and applicable requirements before using a resource. Valuation, lease interpretation, housing decisions and maintenance approvals remain with responsible people; a screening summary is not a guarantee of fair or compliant outcomes.

resources.name: Property Valuation AI

resources.name: Lease Abstraction AI

resources.name: Tenant Screening Copilot
resources.description: Evaluate document checks and screening summaries with relevant, permitted criteria. Keep housing decisions and their explanations with an authorized human reviewer.

resources.name: Rental Listing Optimizer
resources.description: Compare proposed pricing, descriptions, photo order and publication channels for one listing. Verify factual accuracy and obtain approval before publishing changes.

resources.name: Facility Maintenance Planner
resources.description: Define maintenance priorities, service history, scheduling limits and contractor assignments. Evaluate any predictive suggestion against records and approved work orders.

resources.name: Real Estate Market Radar
resources.description: Compare price trends, available inventory and demand by area and period. Check data freshness, coverage and assumptions before interpreting a market signal.

fr.intro: La collection Batch 96, présentée le 6 octobre 2026, couvre six tâches immobilières, de l’évaluation à l’étude du marché. Utilisez les pages des applications et leurs dépôts pour définir un petit essai avec des données explicites et une validation humaine.

Confirmez les fonctions réelles, les licences, les droits d’accès et les exigences applicables avant utilisation. L’évaluation, l’interprétation des baux, les décisions de location et les autorisations de maintenance restent sous responsabilité humaine ; une synthèse de candidature ne garantit pas un résultat équitable ou conforme.
